Response.ArrivalInstr: On arrival once you've collected your luggage and exited the baggage hall please look out for your driver who will be holding a sign with your name and easyjet holidays on it and will take you to your transfer vehicle.  If you have any difficulty in locating your transfer please call our local partner on +34 965 059 089
Response.DepInstr: When you're going home please ensure you are ready to go with all of your party and their luggage 15 minutes before the advertised time. Two days before you fly home, your departure information including pick-up time will be available at easyjet.w2mdmc.com/en-en (you'll need your 7 digit holiday booking reference) - we'll also send you an SMS with the details. If you have any queries, our local partner is available on +34 965 059 089
